sync.unpairBody: This phone and {{device}} stop syncing. Meetings already on each one stay where they are.
sync.unpairedBy: Unpaired by {{device}}. Pair again to keep syncing.
sync.wipeAsked: {{device}} asked this phone to delete the meetings they shared. They’ve been deleted here.

scan.cameraOff: The camera is off for {{app}}. Turn it on in Settings to scan the code.
scan.expired: That code has expired. Show a new one on your computer.
scan.notFound: Couldn’t find your computer. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi.
scan.localNetwork: {{app}} needs the local network to find your computer. Turn it on in Settings.

sync.audioOnDeviceHint: Play it there. This phone has the notes and the transcript.
sync.refiningHint: The transcript can’t be edited until it comes back.
sync.deletedHere: Deleted here. It will be deleted on {{device}} the next time you sync.

error.unreachable: Couldn’t reach your computer. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi.
error.refused: Your computer no longer accepts this phone. Pair them again.
error.upgradeRequired: One of the two apps needs an update before they can sync.
error.storageFull: There isn’t enough storage space to finish syncing.
error.internal: Sync stopped because of a problem. Try again.
